+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+import time
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[0]))
+
+from app.store import memo_get, memo_put, DiskCache
+from app.config import CACHE_TTL
+
+# Test 1: Verify stale memo entries are deleted
+print("Test 1: Memo staleness")
+memo_put("test", {"price": 100})
+print(f"  After put: {memo_get('test')}")
+
+# Simulate time passing by manually editing the stored time
+from app import store
+stored_at, value = store._MEMO["test"]
+store._MEMO["test"] = (stored_at - CACHE_TTL - 1, value)  # Make it stale
+
+result = memo_get("test")
+print(f"  After expiry: {result}")
+print(f"  Entry still in _MEMO? {'test' in store._MEMO}")
+
+# Test 2: Verify stale disk entries are deleted
+print("\nTest 2: Disk cache staleness")
+cache = DiskCache("./var/cache_test")
+cache.put("disk_test", {"price": 200})
+print(f"  File exists: {cache._path('disk_test').exists()}")
+
+result = cache.get("disk_test")
+print(f"  Fresh read: {result}")
+
+# Make file stale by changing mtime
+import os
+cache_file = cache._path("disk_test")
+old_mtime = time.time() - CACHE_TTL - 1
+os.utime(cache_file, (old_mtime, old_mtime))
+
+result = cache.get("disk_test")
+print(f"  After expiry: {result}")
+print(f"  File still exists? {cache._path('disk_test').exists()}")
